title: Make the team hand off, verify and show its work reliably
request:
Based on how the bot-herdr mod works right now, what changes would bring meaningful improvements that help the agents (Orchestrator, Design, Dev, QA, Research, Scout) work better and collaborate better? Discuss, research, then create a detailed improvement plan.

The agreed plan: bh plan show p-20261113-bkli

steps.title: Board posts and step updates record who made them by default (Dev)
Task file and board writes are locked, with board numbers that never repeat (Dev)
`hc` calls and harness turns get timeouts, so one stuck agent cannot stall the Orchestrator (Dev)
`bh report` files a child's report on the task with a `done` board entry and closes its step; `bh inbox` lists unread reports; `bh task show` lists reports (Dev)
A child's own brief carries its task, plan, parent and report path, and each resumed turn gets a short "brief update" with only what changed (Dev)
`bh task show` prints a bounded board (counts, last five entries), and briefs teach `bh board read --since` (Dev)

report.summary: Steps 4-6: report recorded on the task, bh inbox, brief update, bounded board; 205 tests pass, bh check PASS

steps.title: `bh check` says how many checks and tests it ran, writes a receipt per run, and when nothing targeted covers the change it runs the project's full test command instead (Dev)
`bh check` and `bh classify qa-risk` read the task's own worktree and the content of untracked files; the classifier can no longer lower a flagged area to NONE (Dev)
Test selection finds the mod's own tests, which load through `lib(...)` and `new URL(...)` (Dev)

report.summary: Steps 7-9: bh check counts, receipts and full-suite fallback; worktree + untracked content + area floor in qa-risk; test selection by path tail; 217 tests pass, bh check PASS

steps.title: The QA gate gets the plan's acceptance criteria, the task's report paths and a fallback risk when none was classified; `qa.md` and `reviewer.md` merge into one rule set; the verdict is stored on the task (Dev, QA review)

report.summary: Step 10: review context (criteria, reports, receipts, risk) + bh gate verdicts; bh check falls back to the suite only and names what ran; roles merged; 223 tests pass, bh check PASS

steps.title: Each writing child (Dev, Design) runs in its own worktree on a branch from the task's current head; `bh merge <child>` commits the child's changes on its branch, merges them into the task's tree, then removes that worktree and branch; read-only seats (Scout, Research, panel, QA review) stay in the task's tree (Dev)

report.summary: Gate 2 fixes: guarded stale takeover + token-verified release (30x2x20 and 3x8 stress), commit-aware changeHash, verdict counts fail/skipped, no phantom command, store-based worktree paths; five suite runs pass, bh check PASS

steps.title: Every agent turn's reply is kept (one entry per turn), and the feed reads them all, so no reply is lost when an agent exits (Dev engine, Design feed)
An agents rail beside the chat lists every agent grouped needs-you, working and idle, each with what it is doing now and for how long; a click opens its terminal (Design)

`bh task show --json` gives each step its events in order: board posts, the report summary, `bh check` receipts (tests passed of run), the merge's diff stat (+added −removed) and the owning agent's current action (Dev)

report.summary: Gate 3 fixes: report/merge shown once per step, usage in bh task list, best-effort usage capture, Codex input minus cache, link-based lock give-back, forBrief newline; 253 pass, bh check PASS

steps.title: A live task tracker card in the chat, after your mockup: title, the working agents' chip and done/total; a timeline of steps joined by a line, each with its agent's icon, title and time; a step opens to show its events on a branch of the line; the active step carries a live action word ("Writing", "Running tests") and its elapsed time; a step that needs you shows a dashed amber ring and a "Needs you" pill that opens its question (Design)

report.summary: Steps 15 + 20 UI done: live tracker card in chat (timeline, branch events, live word/time, Needs you) and usageText on tracker header, task page and step rows; 8 steps tests, bh check PASS, herdr-app check ok, tsc clean

steps.title: Child reports are grouped under the team turn they answered, behind an "N child reports" row (Design)

report.summary: Steps 12 feed + 16: chat reads every replies/*.jsonl (all turns, live or dead; first sight records history only) with logSeen kept per key, .md only for agents without a log; child runs fold into one 'N child reports' row drawn as one measured entry, opening with a height transition to its reports (3 lines + Show all); 5 pure tests; herdr-app check ok, tsc clean, bh check PASS

steps.title: Every page tab keeps its label and shows its open-question count; the active tab is marked by a thin border instead of a filled, expanded tab (Design)
The task page shows the board and links each step's reports (Design)

report.summary: Step 18: step report link opens the file with its summary under the title; Board section newest-first (10, then Show all N) with kind tones, agent ink, age and Report links; pure helpers in signals.js tested (6 pass); herdr-app check ok, tsc clean, bh check PASS 77 tests

steps.title: Copy and state fixes: "Asked the Orchestrator to resume" until it does, a failed Pause is shown, plan seats show working/waiting/done, reply actions reachable from the keyboard (Design)
Per-turn token and time usage is captured where the harness reports it; `bh usage` totals it per agent and task, and the task page and tracker show it (Dev, Design)

report.summary: Step 20: per-turn usage captured for Claude and Codex, bh usage totals with minutes-only lines for harnesses without tokens

steps.title: Knowledge proposals in reports are listed by `bh knowledge inbox`, and the brief's knowledge budget cuts by section, not mid-file (Dev)

report.summary: Step 21: bh knowledge inbox lists new report proposals; forBrief cuts knowledge by whole sections and names the cut ones

steps.title: Role texts updated for all of the above, then a live two-agent run on a throwaway task proves the path end to end (Orchestrator, QA)

focusAreas: security boundaries: the wrong user, no user and an expired session are refused, and no secret leaks
destructive operations: they touch only what they should, and a failure halfway leaves things recoverable
concurrency: races, ordering, double runs, and a lock or claim that is never released
state transitions and recovery: no illegal or stuck state, and a crash or failed step recovers
isolation: work stays inside its branch, worktree and permission boundaries
riskFactors: a wide change: 30 files, 2782 changed lines across 4 modules (mods/bot-herdr, mods/bot-herdr/engine, .bot-herdr/tasks/t-20261113-n9rt and 1 more)
tests changed with it: test/agents-reply.test.mjs, test/feed-thread.test.mjs, test/headless.test.mjs and 9 more
qa.reasoning: HIGH: security: .bot-herdr/tasks/t-20261113-n9rt/task.json ("secret"); destructive operations: mods/bot-herdr/chat.js ("truncate"); concurrency: .bot-herdr/plans/p-20261111-9dkc/comments.json ("locks"). the engine's rules (Jev is off or had nothing to read).
